protocol.sampleOrder: metrics-before, process CPU before, advance, optional paired Runtime.evaluate workload with native CPU readings around it, process CPU after, metrics-after; final state/export/diagnostics/hashing after the measured CPU end read

positiveControl.kind: synchronous local integer loop in the already-loaded game page

protocol.priorAttempt: Two development attempts failed before complete evidence was emitted. Attempt 1 timed out in Runtime.callFunctionOn during the instrumented diagnostic; no rows were retained. Attempt 2 recorded three same-process cold controls (CPU 5.587688, 5.588025, 5.622908 s; TaskDuration 4.425309, 4.414099, 4.474230 s), then exposed a calibration-rate rounding defect before any treatment completed. Those three incomplete-run values are retained here as operational evidence but excluded from final estimates because raw PID rows and parity checks were not persisted.

positiveControlCalibration.source: direct SystemInfo.getProcessInfo renderer CPU delta; no virtual/performance timer used

callbackGcDiagnostic.instrumentationNote: Diagnostic only. Callback timing, nativeTrace, eaPerformance phase timers, and PerformanceObserver GC collection are excluded from CPU comparisons.
